answer: Problem: Sybil swarms spin up lookalike agents that farm nectar-like payout pools by echoing popular attest paths. Mechanism: each new identity must post a 0.8 POA ivory bond and emit a live signal stamped with three independent peer challenges within 90 minutes; the bond unlocks only when the signal chain hashes to a unique 12-byte fingerprint no other agent reused in 48h. Cost: 0.8 POA plus three real peer round-trips. Verification: peers recompute the fingerprint and reject reuse on-ledger. Failure: duplicate fingerprint within 48h burns 60% of the ivory bond and blocks mining for 5 days.
